Pick a track. The player, and this page, take their colors from the cover.

Your music comes first. Nothing gets in the way.

MusoPhone is an independent, aesthetic YouTube Music client built around one idea: the song deserves the whole screen.

Hi-Res audio

Play FLAC and ALAC from a configured module source, with YouTube Music as the fallback.

Open source

Free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0. Explore the code, inspect it and contribute.

Simple Google sign-in

Sign in with your Google account to connect your YouTube Music experience, without a complicated setup.

YouTube Music client

Discover and enjoy your YouTube Music library through a dedicated Android music player.

01 / 08

01

The player wears the cover.

A Material palette is extracted from the album art, so every track gets its own colors. Eight accent palettes cover the rest of the app.

02

Lyrics that keep time.

Word and syllable level highlighting with an Apple-like animation. Romanized pronunciation and translate buttons sit under the lyrics.

03

Or take the whole screen.

Large type, the artwork as a small header, and favorite and share within reach. Lyrics come from twelve providers: lrc.red, BiniLyrics, BetterLyrics, PaxSenix, LyricsPlus, SimpMusic, Unison, Megalobiz, KuGou, LRCLIB, Musixmatch and Genius.

04

Listen Now.

Top picks for you, mood mixes and your recents, with a mini player resting above the dock.

05

Start from a feeling.

Mood and genre tiles give you somewhere to begin.

06

Your sources, together.

Downloads, local music and Spotify sit side by side as sources. Create playlists, or import them from Spotify.

07

Search everything.

Search YouTube, your Library or Addons from one field, with recent searches kept below.

08

Your listening, on your device.

Stats are measured by what actually played on this device: top songs, artists and albums for the week, month, year or all time.

All the details.

01 · Lyrics

Word and syllable highlighting from twelve providers.

02 · Audio

FLAC and ALAC from a module source, YouTube Music as fallback. Bit-perfect USB output.

03 · Playback

Gapless, crossfade from 0 to 12 seconds, Automix (beta), speed from 0.5× to 2×, skip silence, sleep timer and the system equalizer.

04 · Look

Colors drawn from the album art, over an animated canvas.

05 · Network

Separate quality ceilings for Wi-Fi and mobile data, plus codec, bit depth and sample rate in stats for nerds.

06 · Offline

Downloads with embedded metadata, and your local library.

07 · Integrations

Discord Rich Presence with the live track, artist, album and progress. Scrobbling to Last.fm and ListenBrainz. Pluggable module sources you can add, edit, test and health-check.

08 · Requirements

Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer. Builds for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64.

09 · Appearance

Eight accent palettes and artwork-driven theming.

10 · Updates

In-app updates from official GitHub Releases, verified before install.

11 · Account

Simple Google sign-in. Spotify playlists and Liked Songs play too.

12 · License
